done_when: This repo's forge.toml and the forge.toml that forge init writes set [models.review] to gpt-6-sol with xhigh effort, and no Forge default names gpt-6-astra

findings.body: This test runs the real `forge init` command and checks the generated review model. The changed `tests/test_codex_reader.py:164-176` already runs the same command through `_fresh_client` and asserts the same review model and effort. A regression in either value fails that existing test, so this adds another full repository setup without covering a distinct failure.
findings.title: Simpler: remove the duplicate init test → keep the existing command assertion

why: Autoreview and other Astra passes burn too many tokens; the owner moved all Astra work to Sol at xhigh effort on 2026-09-28
